# TradeSites Co.

> Website design and build for trade and home-service businesses in the United States.
> One flat price of $499, delivered in five business days. The finished site is shown
> to the customer before any payment is taken.

## What we do

TradeSites Co. builds complete, mobile-first websites for plumbers, HVAC contractors,
electricians, roofers, landscapers, painters, concrete contractors, cleaners, pest
control, tree services, towing companies and general handymen.

## Pricing

- **Website: $499, one time.** Not a subscription. Includes up to five pages, all
  copywriting, mobile-first design, tap-to-call, a quote request form, live Google
  reviews, structured data for AI and search visibility, Google setup, and the first
  year of hosting.
- **Care Plan: $29/month, optional.** Hosting, SSL, daily backups, unlimited small
  edits, the Instant Answer Assistant, and monthly reporting. No contract. Never required.
- Add-ons, each priced publicly on the site: extra page $49, online booking $149,
  Instant Answer Assistant $99, before/after gallery $99, Google Business Profile
  setup $79, logo design $129, online payments $149, extra service-area page $39,
  rush 48-hour delivery $149.

## How it works

1. The customer answers six questions by email. About ten minutes. No phone calls.
2. TradeSites Co. builds the entire site. Five business days.
3. The customer reviews a private preview link and requests changes.
4. The customer pays $499 only if they want to keep it. Otherwise they owe nothing.

## What makes us different

- No payment is taken before the customer sees the finished website.
- No required monthly fee, and the customer owns the domain and the site outright.
- No sales calls, meetings or discovery sessions.
- Every site is built to be readable by AI assistants: schema.org structured data,
  plain-language question-and-answer content, an llms.txt file, and a robots.txt
  that explicitly permits AI crawlers.
- We do not publish testimonials, review counts or client numbers we have not earned.
  We are a new company and say so plainly on our site.

## Honest limitations

- We cannot guarantee a Google ranking or that any AI assistant will recommend a
  customer's business. We build the technical foundation that makes it possible.
- The strongest local ranking factor is a Google Business Profile, which we offer to
  set up for $79 but which is separate from the website itself.
